fichas.title: University facilities and space requirements
fichas.summary: The page outlines central university facilities, basic teaching-space needs, and differing room requirements by subject. A campus or hall is shown connected to auditorium, canteen, library, technology, administration, scientific staff and lecture facilities, with student halls, sport and parking also represented.

fichas.title: Normal lecture theatre for humanities
fichas.summary: A normal lecture-theatre arrangement is shown for humanities, with seating raked at a low pitch. The page notes that humanities lecture theatres have no particular requirements for blackboards or projection. Seating visibility is illustrated through a listener-curve diagram.
